description: AI cluster fabrics connect thousands of accelerators.

name: Antimony
description: Flame retardants, lead-acid batteries, semiconductor dopants. China mine production = 60,000 t of 100,000 t world total in 2024 (60% share).

name: Battery-grade Lithium Refining
description: Conversion of lithium concentrate/brine into battery-grade lithium carbonate/hydroxide.

name: BLDC drone motors
description: Brushless DC motors for UAV propulsion, dependent on sintered NdFeB magnets. DSI risk: India lacks a domestic motor base at drone grade. Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: C4ISR & network-centric software
description: Systems-integration and battle-management software a domestic strength.

name: CAMYEN Catamarca Lithium Blocks (5)
description: Five brine-type lithium blocks (Cortadera-I, Cortadera-VII, Cortadera-VIII, Cateo-2022-01810132, Cortadera-VI) totalling 15,703 hectares in Catamarca

name: Captive and renewable power for data centres (opportunity surface)
description: Captive and renewable power for data centres is an AI Infrastructure opportunity surface in corridor 3.

name: Carbon fibre (PAN-based)
description: Carbon fibre; missile/airframe composite; Toray (JP), Hexcel (US), SGL (DE) dominate; MIDHANI pilot.

name: CERT-In Cyber Security Directions (28 April 2022)
description: 6-hour cyber-incident reporting, VPN KYC, on-soil log retention for Indian entities.

name: CMP slurries and pads
description: Chemical-mechanical planarisation consumables. Import-dependent; a Tier-2 invest-now materials opportunity.

name: Cobalt
description: Battery cathode stabiliser. China refines 78% of global cobalt (2024, up from 74% in 2023).

name: Cobalt Sulphate Refining
description: Conversion of cobalt hydroxide / crude metal into battery-grade cobalt sulphate. China refines 78% of global cobalt (IEA, 2024).

name: Cooled IR focal-plane arrays
description: Near-total import of cooled IR FPAs. A foundational sensor chokepoint.

name: Copper
description: Conductor for electrification (EVs, grid, renewables).

name: Counter-UAS / anti-drone systems
description: Active operational pull post-Op Sindoor; soft-kill strong, DEW hard-kill emerging.

name: CoWoS advanced packaging
description: CoWoS advanced packaging is a critical package-integration route for high-end AI accelerators.

name: Critical Mineral Recycling / Urban Mining
description: Recovery of critical minerals from fly ash, tailings, red mud and end-of-life products (e-waste, spent batteries).

relationships.name: Rare Earth Elements (magnet: Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb)

description: Data-centre build-out is an AI Infrastructure opportunity surface in corridor 3.

name: Data-centre electrical and mechanical components (opportunity surface)
description: Data-centre electrical and mechanical components is an AI Infrastructure opportunity surface in corridor 3.

name: Defence Acquisition Procedure 2020
description: DAP 2020; governs capital procurement; introduced Buy(Indian-IDDM), Make-I/II, Strategic Partnership model.

name: Defence Semiconductor / GaN-SiC Capability (chokepoint)
description: The sensor/EW chokepoint — GaN/SiC RF chips for radar/EW/missiles; DRDO cracked indigenous GaN at pilot scale in 2026.

name: Defence-grade semiconductors
description: Rad-hard / trusted chips imported; ISM fabs not yet at defence node maturity.

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
description: India's horizontal data-protection statute; Presidential assent 11 Aug 2023.

relationships.name: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025
description: Operational rules under the DPDP Act; notified 13 Nov 2025.

name: Drone battery packs
description: Li-ion/Li-Po packs with BMS assembled for UAVs; India packs domestically but imports nearly all cells (~84% of Li-ion cell imports from China, FY25-26 customs). Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Drone flight controller
description: The drone's autopilot computer (MCU/SoC + IMU + firmware). ~90% of small-drone flight controllers are Chinese-sourced; DSI risk rank 4 (India 33 vs China 90). Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Drone microcontrollers and SoCs
description: MCUs/SoCs (STM32-class and above) for flight control and companion computing; wholly imported. DSI risk rank 3. Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Drone Rules 2021
description: India's civil drone regulatory framework: forms cut 25 to 5, approvals 72 to 4, drones to 500 kg, ~90% of airspace Green Zone to 400 ft.

name: Electronic design automation (EDA) software
description: Chip-design software layer. The Big-3 — Synopsys (~31%), Cadence (~30%), Siemens EDA (~13%) — hold over 70% of the market; the most entrenched layer of the semiconductor value chain. Mapped in The Opportunity Beyond the Fab (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Electronic speed controller
description: Power-electronics module driving BLDC motors; global supply concentrated in Chinese makers (Hobbywing, T-Motor). Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Electronic warfare & ELINT
description: DLRL + Astra Microwave + Data Patterns give real depth; some RF front-ends imported.

name: EO/IR sensors & seekers
description: Tonbo/others integrate well but IR detectors and seeker cores are imported.

name: Fighter aero-engines (gas turbine)
description: Kaveri did not reach production; fighters fly on imported GE/Saturn cores. The deepest single gap.

name: Gallium
description: Critical input for GaN/compound-semi and RF/power devices; China controls ~98-99% with export controls.

name: GaN-on-SiC RF MMIC
description: GaN-on-SiC monolithic microwave ICs; backbone of modern AESA radar, EW, seekers; ~90% import dependent.

name: Germanium
description: Infrared optics, fibre optics, space photovoltaics. China is the leading global producer (~60% of mine/refinery output; 68% per USGS-cited ~2021 data)

name: Germanium IR optics
description: Germanium lenses for thermal imaging; import-dependent chokepoint (DSI rank 6). EON Space Labs develops germanium-free alternatives. Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: GNSS navigation modules
description: Satellite-navigation receivers (GPS/NavIC) for UAV positioning; import-dependent. Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Graphite (battery-anode grade)
description: Largest anode material by weight in Li-ion cells; China ~90% battery-grade refining with export curbs.

name: Heavyweight torpedoes & UW weapons
description: Varunastra indigenous; some homing and propulsion subsystems imported.

name: High-bandwidth memory (HBM)
description: HBM is the memory chokepoint for AI accelerators. TrendForce and Counterpoint identify SK hynix, Samsung and Micron as the three principal suppliers,

name: High-energy Li-ion cells
description: Packs assembled domestically; cells imported. Rides ACC-PLI, not defence-specific.

name: Hypersonics & scramjet propulsion
description: HSTDV flight-tested; a frontier where India is a credible early mover.

name: IC substrate
description: Engineered package substrate carrying the die and connecting it to the board. India has no domestic producer at scale; Shinko, IBIDEN and Unimicron hold roughly 70% of the world market. Glass-core substrates are the emerging frontier variant.

name: IIT Hyderabad
description: IIT Hyderabad: VLSI and device fab

name: IIT Hyderabad — HealthTech research groups
description: IIT Hyderabad academic institution with active AI-MedTech research groups — included as ecosystem capability.

name: IIT Kharagpur — AI School of Medical Science & Engineering
description: IIT Kharagpur hosts AI-MedTech research programmes.

name: IIT Madras — Center for Integrative Health Research
description: IIT Madras hosts active MedTech research centres; included as ecosystem capability.

name: Imaging IR seeker
description: Imaging IR seekers for missiles; DRDO RCI developing; Rafael/IAI primary sources for QRSAM/ATGM classes.

name: India Stack
description: Public digital infrastructure layers (Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, e-KYC, e-Sign, Account Aggregator).

name: IndiaAI Compute Portal
description: The IndiaAI Compute Portal is the public marketplace for subsidised AI compute access.

name: Katghora Lithium & PGE Block
description: Critical-mineral block in Karnataka awarded to Vedanta Limited. Contains lithium and platinum-group-elements mineralisation.

name: Kawalapur Rare Earth Elements Block
description: REE block (~400 hectares) in Maharashtra awarded to Coal India Limited under Composite Licence in April 2025. First REE block won by CIL.

name: Liquid cooling
description: Liquid cooling is a physical-infrastructure constraint and opportunity for AI workloads because rack densities are rising sharply.

name: Liquid cooling and high-density thermal systems (opportunity surface)
description: Liquid cooling and high-density thermal systems is an AI Infrastructure opportunity surface in corridor 3.

name: Lithium
description: Core battery metal; India ~100% import-dependent, refining China-routed; the defining import-dependency mineral.

name: Lithography systems
description: Photolithography scanners/steppers; the deepest equipment chokepoint. India imports an estimated ~99% [estimated]; advanced EUV dominated by ASML.

name: Loitering munitions
description: Domestic integration strong; seekers and some subsystems imported.

name: Magnet-free EV traction motor
description: EV traction-motor architectures — externally-excited (wound-rotor) synchronous, switched-reluctance and advanced induction — that deliver competitive torque density without NdFeB rare-earth permanent magnets, removing the single largest rare-earth dependency in the EV bill of materials.

relationships.name: Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets

name: MALE / HALE UAV platforms
description: TAPAS-BH delays; high-end ISR met by imported MQ-9B. Integration ahead of payload.

name: Metrology and inspection tools
description: Measurement and defect-inspection equipment. India imports an estimated ~88% [estimated]; concentrated in KLA, Applied Materials.

name: MOSIP
description: Modular Open Source Identity Platform (IIIT Bangalore, 2018; Aadhaar model). Deployed in Philippines, Ethiopia, Morocco + advanced/pilot in 9+ countries; 100M+ IDs by 2023. India EXPORTS sovereign-identity software.

name: Motor-control power electronics
description: Inverters and motor-control electronics that enable magnet-free motor architectures; magnet-free designs shift performance and cost from the magnet to the power-electronics and control layer, making the controller the value-bearing subsystem.

name: Multilayer / HDI PCB
description: High-density interconnect printed circuit boards; ~88% of India's bare PCBs are imported (FY24-25). Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Natural Graphite
description: Anode material for lithium-ion cells. China mines ~80% of global natural graphite, controls 99% of spherical graphite refining and >80% of coated sphe

name: Naval propulsion (marine engines)
description: Warships run on imported MTU/GE/Pielstick; indigenisation early.

name: Networking and optical interconnects (opportunity surface)
description: Networking and optical interconnects is an AI Infrastructure opportunity surface in corridor 3.

name: Nickel (battery-grade sulphate)
description: High-purity nickel sulphate is the battery-relevant form.

name: Optical transceivers
description: Optical transceivers and high-speed interconnects are required for AI-cluster networking and long-haul cloud connectivity.

name: OSAT / ATMP services
description: Outsourced semiconductor assembly, test and packaging. Top-3 (ASE, Amkor, JCET) hold over 60% of OSAT revenue (TrendForce 2025). India's ISM-approved units are concentrated here. Mapped in The Opportunity Beyond the Fab (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Photoresist
description: Light-sensitive polymer critical to lithography and the single sharpest semiconductor chokepoint. Four Japanese firms (JSR, Tokyo Ohka, Shin-Etsu, Fujifilm) control ~87-91% of global supply, rising toward ~91% for advanced EUV grades [V1]. India has effectively zero domestic capability; a Korea/Europe JV is the highest-leverage materials intervention.

name: Positive Indigenisation List
description: MoD Lists I-V (2020-2024) of items reserved for Indian procurement; ~5,000+ Line Items across lists.

name: PX4 / ArduPilot autopilot stack
description: Open-source drone autopilot software stacks; no licence chokepoint — the software layer where India competes on merit. Analysed in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Quantum technologies (QKD, sensing)
description: DRDO/ISRO QKD demos; early TRL but a genuine leapfrog surface.

name: Rare Earth Elements (magnet: Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb)
description: Magnet rare earths (neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium, terbium) underpin sintered NdFeB permanent magnets used in EV traction motors, wind turbines,

name: Rare Earth Elements / Neodymium-Praseodymium
description: NdPr drives EV/wind/defence magnets; India ~100% China-dependent for finished NdFeB (imported 53,748 t FY25).

relationships.name: Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets

name: Rare-earth permanent magnets (NdFeB)
description: ~100% import, China-dominated. New sintered-magnet scheme targets ~2028 first output.

name: Rare-earth separation and refining (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb)
description: India's only operating separation capacity is IREL's Udyogamandal and OSCOM REEP.

name: Rare-Earth Separation and Refining (Solvent Extraction)
description: Upstream of magnet manufacturing; converts mixed rare-earth concentrates into high-purity individual oxides (Nd₂O₃, Pr₆O₁₁, Dy₂O₃, Tb₄O₇).

name: RBI Storage of Payment System Data directive (2018)
description: RBI circular of 6 April 2018 mandating on-soil storage of payment-system data.

name: RISC-V processor IP
description: Open instruction-set processor IP — the open door in an otherwise closed IP layer; no monopoly yet (SiFive ~15%, Andes, Ventana). India's SHAKTI-lineage challengers: InCore, Mindgrove. Mapped in The Opportunity Beyond the Fab (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Semicon 2.0 Ecosystem
description: The eight upstream semiconductor streams beyond fab and OSAT — materials, chemicals, equipment, precision manufacturing, advanced packaging, testing, fab automation and industrial software. Together ~65% of value-chain value and ~78% of the gross-margin pool. Techadyant models a ~Rs 95,500 crore ten-year addressable opportunity, ~Rs 45,500 crore serviceable by 2035 [modelled]. Formalised by India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 (Cabinet-approved 15 Jul 2026, ~Rs 1.27 lakh crore, six pillars).

relationships.name: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors

name: Semiconductor Advanced Packaging (opportunity stream)
description: 2.5D/3D and chiplet packaging, OSAT/ATMP deepening into the value-capture layer. ~Rs 9,160 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled]. India OSAT cost-arbitrage vs Taiwan a defensible moat.

name: Semiconductor Chemicals (opportunity stream)
description: Photoresists, etchants, CMP slurries and pads, high-purity solvents and specialty process gases. ~Rs 4,420 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled]. Contains the photoresist chokepoint.

name: Semiconductor Equipment (opportunity stream)
description: Lithography support, metrology and inspection, deposition, vacuum, gas delivery and wafer-handling systems. Largest pool at ~Rs 9,580 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled]. India imports ~99% of lithography and ~88% of metrology tools [estimated].

name: Semiconductor Fab Automation (opportunity stream)
description: Factory automation, wafer-handling robotics and manufacturing-execution control. ~Rs 2,820 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled].

name: Semiconductor fab equipment
description: Lithography, deposition, etch, metrology tools — each sub-segment a near-oligopoly (ASML litho; Applied Materials, Lam, KLA, Tokyo Electron). Mapped in The Opportunity Beyond the Fab (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Semiconductor Industrial Software (opportunity stream)
description: MES, digital twin and yield-optimisation software. Most asymmetric opportunity — repurposes India IT/engineering base at marginal capital. ~Rs 4,830 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled].

name: Semiconductor Materials (opportunity stream)
description: Silicon, silicon carbide, gallium nitride, quartz, wafers and substrates. Critical enabler; ~Rs 3,100 cr/yr addressable by 2035 [modelled]. India near-fully import-dependent today.

name: Semiconductor Precision Manufacturing (opportunity stream)
description: Precision machining, toolroom capability, cleanroom sub-systems for fab-support machinery. ~Rs 3,430 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled]. High-leverage, repurposes existing engineering base.

name: Semiconductor Testing (opportunity stream)
description: Automated test equipment, probe cards, burn-in and reliability testing. ~Rs 2,740 cr/yr by 2035 [modelled]. Tier-1 speed-up opportunity.

name: Silicon carbide (SiC) devices
description: Wide-bandgap power semiconductors for EVs and power electronics; top-5 (Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Wolfspeed, onsemi, ROHM) held over 90% of 2024 revenue. Mapped in The Opportunity Beyond the Fab (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Single-crystal turbine blade
description: Single-crystal turbine blades; key chokepoint for indigenous aero-engine; DRDO/GTRE + MIDHANI development (limited yield).

name: Sintered NdFeB magnet manufacturing
description: Anchor opportunity for the Rs.7,280 crore Ministry of Heavy Industries scheme (6,000 MTPA target).

name: Sintered NdFeB Permanent Magnet Manufacturing
description: The downstream bottleneck of the rare-earth value chain. Globally 94% of sintered NdFeB magnets are produced in China (IEA, 2024).

name: Small arms & ammunition
description: Mature domestic base; selective propellant and specialty rounds imported.

name: Small UAV (multirotor)
description: Small multirotor unmanned aircraft — the dominant civil/commercial drone class. Finished-drone imports banned (2022) while components remain 'Free': FY25-26 customs recorded $8.3M finished drones vs $767M aircraft/drone parts. Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: Software-defined radio & secure comms
description: SDR and crypto maturing; some RF and waveform IP still external.

name: Sovereign compute / GPU-as-a-service (opportunity surface)
description: Sovereign compute / GPU-as-a-service is an AI Infrastructure opportunity surface in corridor 3.

name: Specialty process gases
description: High-purity electronic gases essential to deposition and etch. India imports an estimated ~92% [estimated]. Part of the chemicals stream.

name: Specialty Semiconductor Gases and Photoresist
description: Photoresist, specialty gases, high-purity chemicals, wafers; >90% imported — the materials-layer chokepoint.

name: Spherical Graphite Processing
description: Purification and shaping of natural graphite into spherical graphite for battery anodes.

name: Submarine air-independent propulsion
description: DRDO fuel-cell AIP indigenous and maturing for Kalvari retrofit.

name: Tactical & strategic missiles
description: DRDO depth: Astra, BrahMos, Agni, Akash. Among India's strongest sovereign capabilities.

name: Titanium sponge
description: Titanium sponge; aerospace-grade; Japan (Toho Titanium, Sumitomo) and Kazakhstan dominate; MIDHANI downstream.

name: Tungsten
description: Hardmetals, machining, defence penetrators. China mine production = 67,000 t of 81,000 t world total in 2024 (82.7%); holds ~52% of world reserves (2.

name: Uncooled thermal imaging cameras
description: Microbolometer-based thermal cameras for drone payloads; India integrates but imports detector cores. Catalogued in Who Builds India's Drones? (Techadyant Labs, 2026).

name: UPS and power electronics
description: UPS, power electronics, switchgear and transformers are critical data-centre electrical layers.

relationships.name: Data-centre electrical and mechanical components (opportunity surface)

name: Urban mining / critical mineral recycling
description: Backed by the Rs.1,500 crore Ministry of Mines scheme (3 Sep 2025); 270-300 kt/year capacity target.
